review:
Sugar Supreme Powernudge is a 6x6 cluster game using Pragmatic Play's Powernudge mechanic. Five or more matching symbols pay, and a single cluster of more than 15 symbols can be worth up to 100x the bet.

When a winning cluster lands in the base game, Powernudge may trigger at random: reels containing a winning symbol nudge down one position, a new symbol appears at the top, and any new wins pay. Winning positions gain a multiplier during the nudges, starting at 1x and increasing by 1 each time a winning symbol lands there. Three or more scatters trigger the bonus. The advertised maximum is 5,000x and the RTP is 96.09%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
